headline: Microsoft's AI revenue concentration on OpenAI reaches critical dependency levels
body: Microsoft's regulatory filings reveal that approximately 70% of its AI revenue depends entirely on OpenAI, creating substantial concentration risk in the vendor landscape. For healthcare organizations evaluating AI partnerships, this dependency raises questions about long-term stability and vendor viability when building clinical workflows around Microsoft-OpenAI integrated solutions. Recent reports of research integrity concerns and agent security gaps at OpenAI add operational risk to healthcare deployments that rely on these foundational models. Healthcare AI buyers should assess whether their EHR and clinical decision support strategies can maintain flexibility if this partnership shifts or faces regulatory scrutiny.
